pages.title: Chess Scholarships for Kids in Atlanta
pages.description: Coaching, a chess set of their own, and paid entries to rated tournaments, for students in grades 3-8 from underserved communities in Atlanta.

pages.title: About Us
pages.description: Rule the Board began after a summer of teaching chess at Odyssey. Meet the team behind the scholarship and read our 2025-26 impact report.

pages.title: Chess Programs for Grades 3-8
pages.description: Two chess programs for grades 3-8: a summer class for students who have never touched a piece, and a year-long scholarship for those ready to compete.

pages.title: Apply for a Chess Scholarship
pages.description: One year of chess coaching, paid tournament entries, and your own equipment. Open to students in grades 3-8 who want to take chess seriously.

pages.title: Volunteer or Donate
pages.description: Rule the Board runs entirely on volunteers and donations. Coach, mentor, or give. An hour of your time goes straight to a scholar in Atlanta.

pages.title: Your First Chess Tournament: A Guide
pages.description: Everything Rule the Board scholars need to know before their first rated tournament: pairings, the Swiss system, clock rules, and etiquette.
